title.zh: 规定在新怡诗夏省Bongabon市镇运营与维护急诊医院并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Operation and Maintenance of an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Bongabon, Province of Nueva Ecija, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Operation and Maintenance of an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Bongabon, Province of Nueva Ecija, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3603_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Department of Health, an emergency hospital in the Municipality of Bongabon, Province of Nueva Ecija.

The sum of seventy-five thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the operation and maintenance of said hospital during the current fiscal year. Thereafter, said hospital shall be financed in accordance with the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred thirty-nine.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
